modules.name: seed
owns: SeedService (seed.service.ts) — idempotent demo-data seeding: employees (manager + employee with bcrypt hashes), leave types, leave policies, current-period leave balances, leave requests in multiple states
index.ts (public entry point re-exporting ISeedService + SeedService)
seeds/001_demo_data.ts (knex seed entry that wires SeedService into the knex CLI)

recommended_phases.title: Phase 1 — Seed service module
recommended_phases.rationale: Foundation: ISeedService + SeedService + index.ts under src/modules/seed/. Depends only on shared-date (periodContaining/startOfUtcDay/addMonths for the current accrual period) and shared-types (LeaveTypeCode/EmployeeRole/EmploymentStatus/LeaveStatus enums), plus bcrypt for hashing. No module depends on it, so it is the dependency root.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2 — Knex seed entry + knexfile wiring + seed script
recommended_phases.rationale: Add seeds/001_demo_data.ts (thin entry calling SeedService.seedDemoData), configure the seeds directory + ts-node registration in knexfile.js for the development environment, and add the 'npm run seed' script. Depends on Phase 1.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3 — Dev tooling + docs
recommended_phases.rationale: Root 'npm run dev' (run API + web together), fix web/package.json test script to 'vitest run', and add the README run/seed/credentials section. Independent of the seed code but lands last so the documented commands are verified against the finished seed.

app_notes: This feature adds no API surface and no role-gated access — it is development tooling (a knex seed, npm scripts, and docs). The seed module is a leaf module under src/modules/seed/ that depends only on shared foundations (shared-date for the current accrual period, shared-types for the canonical enums) and bcrypt. It must mint password hashes with the same bcrypt call the auth service verifies (bcrypt.hashSync with cost 10, matching the smoke seed precedent), and must be idempotent (upsert-by-natural-key / delete-then-insert within a transaction so a second run neither duplicates nor fails). Seeded dates are calendar dates in UTC, and the current-period balance is derived via periodContaining(hireDate, accrualPeriodMonths, now) — never a hand-written date. The seed is development-only and is wired into knexfile.js under the development environment's seeds config; it must never run as part of migrate. No existing API contract or route changes.

open_questions.question: How should the root 'npm run dev' script run the API and the web dev server concurrently?
open_questions.impact: Determines whether a new devDependency is added and how cross-platform the one-command startup is.
candidate_options: Add 'concurrently' devDependency and run 'concurrently "npm:start" "npm --prefix web run dev"'
Write a small node script (scripts/dev.js) that spawns both child processes with no new dependency

auth_contract: No API surface or role-gated access is introduced by this feature (seed data, npm scripts, and documentation only).
error_response_contract: No API endpoints are introduced by this feature.
